title: [교외행사] International Creativity Competition (ICC) 2020 run by Telkom University, Indonesia
contentHtml:
We present International Creativity Competition (ICC) 2020 for students, during the stay-at-home period, and total prizes would be shared among various competition categories: Video Competition, Visual Story Telling, News Casting and Short Story Writing. Diploma and Bachelor's degree from any majors are able to take part in the competition, till 7th June 2020. Please visit ICAO's website to find out any updates: https://icao.telkomuniversity.ac.id/international-creativity-competition-2020/  

 

Link for registration: https://bit.ly/ICCREGISTRATION
